name: Karakai Jouzu no Takagi-san
original_name: からかい上手の高木さん
source:
PC mini game that was bundled with the first copies of the first DVD and Blu-ray Disc volume of the "Karakai Jouzu no Takagi-san" anime. Player, who plays as Nishikata, has to max out the hearts in the game's "Tokimeki Gauge."

[From [url=https://www.animenewsnetwork.com/interest/2018-03-01/yuuki-kaji-demoes-karakai-jozu-no-takagi-san-anime-pc-game/.128289]Anime News Network[/url]]
translation:
《擅长捉弄的高木同学》动画第一卷DVD和蓝光碟首批附赠的PC小游戏。玩家扮演西片，需要把游戏中的“心动计量槽”爱心填满。

[来源：[url=https://www.animenewsnetwork.com/interest/2018-03-01/yuuki-kaji-demoes-karakai-jozu-no-takagi-san-anime-pc-game/.128289]Anime News Network[/url]]
